[Goal]

- Please add "[[t]]" and "rounded up to the nearest integer" to the first sentence: "... convert a temperature [[t]] in Celsius (C) to another unit, <<rounded up to the nearest integer>>, as follows:"

- Please correct the spelling of "Farenheit" to "Fahrenheit". You can also change "Reaumur" to "Réaumur" if you want :)

- Please format the numbers used in the conversion equations as {{constants}}. For example, "K = C + {{273,15}}".

[Input]

- In line with the contribution guidelines, please capitalise "line" as "Line". Same goes for the Output line.

- Please add "(in Celsius)" to the end of line 1: "... of the given temperature (in Celsius)."

[Output]

- Please correct "saparated" to "separated".

Thank you :)

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: I like the idea, and it seems fun
Rankine still displayed in the Goal section

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: I think it would be a good challenge, especially in the shortest gamemode

Goal
* Please make the following changes:

  • Celsius => Celsius (C)

  • an other => another

  • unity => unit

  • Rankin => Rankine

* Please use either × or * consistently.

* Please use either fractions or decimals consistently:

  • F: Use 9/5 or 1.8

  • Ra: Use 9/5 or 1.8

  • Re: Use 4/5 or 0.8

Constraints
* The first constraint is incorrect as some [[t]] values are negative.

* Please change "final" to "converted".

* Please move the second constraint to the Output section.

Game modes
* Please disable Reverse mode. Players shouldn't be expected to know or look up the conversion formulas in this mode.

Cases
* All current tests use 2-digit integer inputs. Please update them to cover a broader range of temperatures, including values with 1 to 5 digits, both positive and negative.

Thanks.
